G1300.def: to accomplish thoroughly, i.e. (subjectively) to persist

G1301.def: to watch thoroughly, i.e. (positively and transitively) to observe strictly, or (negatively and reflexively) to avoid wholly

G1303.derivation: middle voice from G1223 (διά) and G5087 (τίθημι);
G1303.def: to put apart, i.e. (figuratively) dispose (by assignment, compact, or bequest)

G1304.derivation: from G1223 (διά) and the base of G5147 (τρίβος);

G1305.derivation: from a compound of G1223 (διά) and G5142 (τρέφω);

G1306.def: to glimmer through, i.e. break (as day)

G1308.def: to bear through, i.e. (literally) transport; usually to bear apart, i.e. (objectively) to toss about (figuratively, report); subjectively, to "differ", or (by implication) surpass
G1308.kjv: be better, carry, differ from, drive up and down, be (more) excellent, make matter, publish, be of more value

G1310.derivation: from G1223 (διά) and a derivative of G5345 (φήμη);
G1310.kjv: blaze abroad, commonly report, spread abroad, fame

G1311.def: to rot thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to ruin (passively, decay utterly, figuratively, pervert)

G1315.derivation: from G1223 (διά) and a derivative of G5495 (χείρ);
G1315.def: to handle thoroughly, i.e. lay violent hands upon

G1316.derivation: from G1223 (διά) and the middle voice of G5563 (χωρίζω);

G1321.derivation: a prolonged (causative) form of a primary verb (to learn);
G1321.def: to teach (in the same broad application)

G1324.def: double, i.e. twin; Didymus, a Christian

G1325.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which is used as an alternative in most of the tenses);
G1325.def: to give (used in a very wide application, properly, or by implication, literally or figuratively; greatly modified by the connection)
G1325.kjv: adventure, bestow, bring forth, commit, deliver (up), give, grant, hinder, make, minister, number, offer, have power, put, receive, set, shew, smite (+ with the hand), strike (+ with the palm of the hand), suffer, take, utter, yield

G1326.def: to wake fully; i.e. arouse (literally or figuratively)

G1327.def: an outlet through, i.e. probably an open square (from which roads diverge)

G1329.def: to explain thoroughly, by implication, to translate

G1330.kjv: come, depart, go (about, abroad, everywhere, over, through, throughout), pass (by, over, through, throughout), pierce through, travel, walk through

G1331.def: to question throughout, i.e. ascertain by interrogation

G1336.derivation: neuter of a compound of G1223 (διά) and a derivative of an alternate of G5342 (φέρω);
G1336.def: carried through, i.e. (adverbially with G1519 (εἰς) and G3588 (ὁ) prefixed) perpetually

G1337.def: having two seas, i.e. a sound with a double outlet

G1338.derivation: from G1223 (διά) and the base of G2425 (ἱκανός);

G1339.def: to stand apart, i.e. (reflexively) to remove, intervene
G1339.kjv: go further, be parted, after the space of

G1340.derivation: from G1223 (διά) and a derivative of G2478 (ἰσχυρός);
G1340.def: to stout it through, i.e. asservate

G1342.def: equitable (in character or act); by implication, innocent, holy (absolutely or relatively)

G1343.def: equity (of character or act); specially (Christian) justification

G1344.def: to render (i.e. show or regard as) just or innocent

G1345.def: an equitable deed; by implication, a statute or decision

G1349.def: right (as self-evident), i.e. justice (the principle, a decision, or its execution)

G1350.derivation: probably from a primary verb (to cast);

G1351.def: equivocal, i.e. telling a different story

G1356.derivation: from the alternate of G2203 (Ζεύς) and the alternate of G4098 (πίπτω);

G1357.derivation: from a compound of G1223 (διά) and a derivative of G3717 (ὀρθός), meaning to straighten thoroughly;

G1359.derivation: from the alternate of G2203 (Ζεύς) and a form of the base of G2877 (κοράσιον);
G1359.def: sons of Jupiter, i.e. the twins Dioscuri

G1360.def: on the very account that, or inasmuch as

G1361.derivation: from the alternate of G2203 (Ζεύς) and G5142 (τρέφω);
G1361.def: Jove-nourished; Diotrephes, an opponent of Christianity

G1362.derivation: from G1364 (δίς) and (probably) the base of G4119 (πλείων);

G1365.def: properly, to duplicate, i.e. (mentally) to waver (in opinion)

G1369.def: to make apart, i.e. sunder (figuratively, alienate)

G1370.derivation: from a derivative of G1364 (δίς) and G4714 (στάσις);

G1371.derivation: from a compound of a derivative of G1364 (δίς) and a derivative of (to cut);
G1371.def: to bisect, i.e. (by extension) to flog severely

G1374.def: two-spirited, i.e. vacillating (in opinion or purpose)

G1377.derivation: a prolonged (and causative) form of a primary verb (to flee;
G1377.def: compare the base of G1169 (δειλός) and G1249 (διάκονος)); to pursue (literally or figuratively); by implication, to persecute
G1377.kjv: ensue, follow (after), given to, (suffer) persecute(-ion), press forward

G1379.def: to prescribe by statute, i.e. (reflexively) to submit to, ceremonially rule

G1380.derivation: a prolonged form of a primary verb, (used only in an alternate in certain tenses;
G1380.def: compare the base of G1166 (δεικνύω)) of the same meaning; to think; by implication, to seem (truthfully or uncertainly)
G1380.kjv: be accounted, (of own) please(-ure), be of reputation, seem (good), suppose, think, trow

G1381.def: to test (literally or figuratively); by implication, to approve
G1381.kjv: allow, discern, examine, X like, (ap-)prove, try

G1382.def: test (abstractly or concretely); by implication, trustiness

G1383.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G1382 (δοκιμή);

G1384.def: properly, acceptable (current after assayal), i.e. approved

G1385.derivation: from G1209 (δέχομαι) (through the idea of holding up);

G1388.derivation: from an obsolete primary verb, (probably meaning to decoy;
G1388.def: compare G1185 (δελεάζω)); a trick (bait), i.e. (figuratively) wile

G1391.def: glory (as very apparent), in a wide application (literal or figurative, objective or subjective)

G1392.def: to render (or esteem) glorious (in a wide application)
G1392.kjv: (make) glorify(-ious), full of (have) glory, honour, magnify

G1394.def: a giving; by implication, (concretely) a gift

G1396.derivation: from a presumed compound of G1401 (δοῦλος) and G71 (ἄγω);
G1396.def: to be a slave-driver, i.e. to enslave (figuratively, subdue)

G1398.def: to be a slave to (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary)
